visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a white off-the-shoulder top and a silver chain necklace, biting into a stuffed bread roll. She closes her eyes and smiles with delight. In the background, a metal security gate and electronic devices are visible under bright natural daylight. (2) A close-up shot transitions to show the bread's interior, packed with cream and green herbs. A man with short dark hair in a black polo shirt appears beside her, both looking into the camera with wide eyes and open mouths in excitement. (3) The scene shifts to the storefront of 'Garlic Boy,' showing trays of golden-brown garlic bread rolls. A woman in a black apron works in the background of the shop. The lighting is bright and industrial inside the bakery. (4) The woman is seen sitting on a street bench, then standing in a crowded urban street, removing her sunglasses. Passers-by are blurred in the background. She presents different varieties of the garlic bread, including one that looks like a pineapple bun. (5) The man and woman are seen together outdoors, eating the bread with high energy. They point at the food and make exaggerated facial expressions of enjoyment. The video concludes with a split-screen montage of their reactions and close-ups of the bread products.
